title: Be prepared -- 60" vs 63" as advertised.
text: Be prepared -- 60" vs 63" as advertised.. Only measured 60". I didn't want the hassle of sending back so just going to deal with what i got. I'm glad i just ordered one set versus the eight I was originally going to order. After reading reviews I noticed this was a hit or miss possibility with the length but I tried my luck. If it wasnt for the length disaster these curtains would have been perfect. Blocked the light and loved the material and classy clean look it gave my window.
